sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface internalization assay: HiBiT-AT1R is detected at the cell surface and undergoes agonist-induced internalization, confirming surface display of the tagged receptor.
sites.rationale: AT1R has no signal peptide (UniProt P30556); residues 1–27 form the extracellular N-terminus and TM1 begins at residue 28 (F), placing the prepend junction 27 residues from the TM boundary, well above the ≥3-residue minimum. The N-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus available for a prepend tag on this 7-TM receptor; the HiBiT cassette in L1 uses its own IL-6 signal sequence to drive surface display, so the tag is extracellular before M1. No specific residue is named in the paper, but exactly one extracellular terminus exists for a prepend, so the position is topology-derived. Python confirms residue_after = M (seq[0]). Human full-length AT1R N-terminally fused to a HiBiT cassette (IL-6 signal sequence + HiBiT + GS linker) expressed in cells; the cassette drives extracellular display of HiBiT at the receptor N-terminus. Used in a receptor internalization assay that monitors surface-displayed receptor.

sources.claim: For the HiBiT-based receptor internalization assay, human full-length AT1R was N-terminally fused to a HiBiT cassette (HiBiT-AT1R), which contained the Interleukin 6-derived signal sequence followed by the HiBiT sequence and a linker (MNSFSTSAFGPVAFSLGLLLVLPAAFPAP VSGWRLFKKIS GGSGGGGSG; HiBiT tag underlined; gene synthesized with codon optimization).

As expected, Myc-AT1-R was mainly detected at the cell surface, demonstrating efficient trafficking of the receptor to the plasma membrane whereas Myc-SNX12 was exclusively confined to intracellular vesicles, in agreement with its specific localization in early endosomes ( Pons et al., 2012 ).

literature_notes: L5 (C-terminal Rluc fusion) is excluded from sites because the AT1R C-terminus (residues 297–359) is intracellular per the topology landmarks; it is recorded in other_positions. L2 introduces the Myc-AT1-R construct and is subsumed by L3/L4 which provide the surface-validation evidence; L3 is used as the primary clip for the Myc site. Both sites map to the same junction (insert_after_residue=0, prepend before M1) but are reported separately because they rest on different ledger lines, different tags, and different species. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for AT1R.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal Rluc fusion to full-length AT1R used in BRET signaling assays; the AT1R C-terminus (residues 297–359) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm and is not a surface site.
